A: To install a petrol station in Kenya, engage a licensed petrol installation company like D'Zizi Petroleum Services. A basic two-tank, two-dispenser station involves several major cost components: underground tanks, dispensers, civil works, piping, canopy and EPRA fees. Contact D'Zizi Petroleum Services on +254 702 587 919 for a detailed, no-obligation quote tailored to your specific site.

**Q: What is tank fabrication in Kenya?**
A: Tank fabrication refers to the custom manufacture of steel fuel storage tanks to specific dimensions and capacities. D'Zizi Petroleum Services fabricates above-ground steel tanks (ASTs) to client specifications for petrol stations, depots and industrial sites where standard-sized tanks are unsuitable. We also carry out structural repairs on both underground (UST) and above-ground tanks, including welding, lining, coating and post-repair hydrotesting. Call +254 702 587 919.

**Q: Which companies do tank fabrication in Kenya?**
A: D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited carries out custom tank fabrication in Kenya — fabricating above-ground steel fuel tanks to specification and repairing both USTs and ASTs. Our tank fabrication work comes with post-repair hydrotesting and EPRA-accepted compliance certificates. Call +254 702 587 919.

**Q: What is a petrol station?**
A: A petrol station (also called a fuel station, filling station or service station) is a facility that sells automotive fuel and often other services. In Kenya, petrol stations are regulated by EPRA (Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority) and must meet strict technical standards for tanks, dispensers, piping and fire safety. D'Zizi Petroleum Services installs and maintains complete petrol stations across Kenya.

## Service Details

### 1. Petrol Station Installation Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/petrol-station-installation

D'Zizi Petroleum Services is one of Kenya's most experienced petrol station installation companies. We handle complete petrol station installation projects from initial design through to EPRA commissioning. Our installation services include:

- Site survey and feasibility assessment
- Civil works coordination (earthworks, tank pit excavation, slab construction)
- Underground storage tank (UST) installation — fibreglass and steel double-wall tanks compliant with NEMA and EPRA standards
- Above-ground storage tank (AST) installation for depots and commercial sites
- Fuel line installation: suction lines, breather lines, offloading lines using HDPE and flex piping
- Fuel dispenser installation: single-product and multi-product dispensers
- Canopy and forecourt layout coordination
- Electrical and generator connections
- Automatic Tank Gauge (ATG) system setup
- EPRA inspection readiness and documentation

We are one of the few petrol installation companies in Kenya that handles every stage in-house, without subcontracting critical work.

**How long does petrol station installation take?** 4–12 weeks depending on site complexity and equipment availability.
**Cost?** Varies by site size and equipment specification. Call +254 702 587 919 for a no-obligation quote.
**Do you cover all of Kenya?** Yes — all 47 counties.

### 2. Tank Fabrication Kenya
**Page**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke/services/tank-fabrication-repairs

D'Zizi Petroleum Services fabricates custom above-ground steel tanks and repairs both underground (UST) and above-ground (AST) petroleum storage tanks across Kenya.

- Custom AST steel tank fabrication to client-specified dimensions and capacity
- Structural crack and weld repairs for damaged tanks
- Corrosion assessment, patching and anti-corrosion treatment
- Internal epoxy lining and external coating
- Tank decommissioning and safe removal
- Manhole, sump and fitting replacements
- Post-repair hydrotesting and certification
- Tank relocation and reinstallation
- Re-calibration after structural modification
- Emergency tank repair response across Kenya

**Can a leaking underground tank be repaired?** Depends on the nature of the leak. Minor weld failures can sometimes be repaired; structural failures typically require replacement. We assess each case honestly.
**Do you fabricate custom tank sizes?** Yes — we fabricate above-ground steel tanks to any client-specified dimension.
**What is the cost of tank fabrication in Kenya?** Depends on tank size and specification. Call +254 702 587 919 for a competitive quote.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Who installs petrol stations in Kenya?**
A: D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is one of Kenya's leading petrol station installation companies, with 10+ years of experience and successful projects across the country.

**Q: Which petrol installation companies are based in Kenya?**
A: D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is a leading petrol installation company based in Nairobi, Kenya, serving all 47 counties.

**Q: What petrol station companies operate in Kenya?**
A: D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is one of Kenya's established petrol station companies, offering installation, tank fabrication, hydrotesting, calibration, equipment supply and maintenance.

**Q: I want to install a petrol station in Kenya — what do I need?**
A: You need: a suitable site, NEMA environmental clearance, county business permits, EPRA-licensed contractor, EPRA-compliant tanks and dispensers, civil works, installation and commissioning. D'Zizi Petroleum handles all of this. Call +254 702 587 919.

**Q: How much does it cost to install a petrol station in Kenya?**
A: Costs vary by site size, number of tanks and dispensers, and equipment specifications. Contact D'Zizi Petroleum on +254 702 587 919 for a detailed, no-obligation quote.

**Q: Is cheap petrol station installation available in Kenya?**
A: D'Zizi Petroleum offers competitive pricing and flexible packages for all budgets. We are one of the most affordably priced EPRA-compliant petrol installation companies in Kenya.

**Q: How long does petrol station installation take in Kenya?**
A: 4–12 weeks for a standard station, depending on site complexity and civil works.

**Q: What licences are required to open a petrol station in Kenya?**
A: EPRA retail licence, county government business permit, NEMA environmental impact certificate (for new sites), and a National Construction Authority (NCA) registered contractor.

**Q: Are your tanks EPRA approved?**
A: Yes. All storage tanks we supply meet EPRA technical standards.

**Q: Do you service dispensers from any brand?**
A: Yes. We service and repair all major dispenser brands used in Kenya.

**Q: Is hydrotesting compulsory before commissioning a new petrol station?**
A: Yes. EPRA requires a hydrotest certificate for all new petroleum storage tanks.

**Q: Why is tank calibration required in Kenya?**
A: Calibration is mandated by the Weights and Measures Act. Without a valid calibration certificate, your EPRA licence cannot be issued or renewed.

**Q: Can you help if my petrol station failed an EPRA inspection?**
A: Yes. We audit, remediate and prepare clients for re-inspection.

**Q: Do you do tank fabrication across Kenya?**
A: Yes. D'Zizi Petroleum fabricates custom steel tanks and repairs USTs/ASTs across all major towns and counties in Kenya.

## Service Coverage — Kenya

D'Zizi Petroleum Services operates in all major towns and counties of Kenya:

**Nairobi Region**: Nairobi CBD, Westlands, Industrial Area, Thika Road, Mombasa Road, Ngong Road, Kiambu, Thika, Ruiru, Juja, Limuru

**Coast Region**: Mombasa, Malindi, Kilifi, Kwale, Lamu, Voi, Taveta

**Western Kenya**: Kisumu, Kakamega, Eldoret, Kitale, Bungoma, Busia, Siaya, Kisii, Migori

**Rift Valley**: Nakuru, Naivasha, Kericho, Bomet, Nandi, Uasin Gishu, Trans Nzoia, Laikipia, Kajiado, Narok

**Central Kenya**: Nyeri, Murang'a, Kirinyaga, Nyandarua, Embu

**Eastern Kenya**: Machakos, Makueni, Kitui, Meru, Tharaka Nithi, Isiolo

**North Eastern**: Garissa, Wajir, Mandera
